data: ALL chart-bearing states (patterns-loaded, legend-loaded, fullscreen-loaded at 1600 and 390) share ONE real 200-bar IRCON 1D OHLCV fixture (2026-02-03 to 2026-11-25) from experiments/data/pattern_cache/candles/1D/IRCON.v3.pkl, with price ₹107.36 and consistent as-of 25 Nov / LAST CANDLE 2026-11-25; S/R bands come from the IRCON pattern fixture's own breakout/target/stop prices. Pattern rows mirror tests/mocks/patternEvidence.ts. Loading (pending matrix), error (mocked 500) and empty states are mocked; all other states use the shared pattern mocks. API routes are mocked in Playwright; no devtools/server restart.

states.covers: Real IRCON pattern row with the shared real 200-bar 1D OHLCV chart docked at 1600 and modal at 390; topmost price tick fully inside the plot at 390. Falling Wedge boundary label, volume, S/R zones, ₹107.36 and 25 Nov / LAST CANDLE 2026-11-25 are consistent; no TLS/TLR text, testids or request params.

Results toolbar with the view controls (Matrix/List/Grid) and BARS history set to 60, proving the view control row carries no TLS/TLR switch. Same fixture rows, no forbidden text and no 390px sideways overflow.

Filters modal with the draft filter rail open: opaque overlay masks page bleed, three columns at 1600; one labelled scrollport with cue and a single stacked column at 390 with no clipped glyph at the edge. Presets, family, Freshness, Structure, 52W gap ≤ %, Base length (days) and Advanced sections are reachable. No TLS only / TLR only options remain.

Same shared real 200-bar IRCON 1D fixture as patterns-loaded, with the chart legend showing 'Falling Wedge' and the indicators menu open (no TLS/TLR entries, S/R zones 2). ₹107.36 / 25 Nov / LAST CANDLE 2026-11-25 are identical to the other chart states.

Fullscreen pattern chart (maximized at 1600, modal with History=3 at 390) on the same shared real 200-bar IRCON 1D fixture; chart toolbar, Falling Wedge boundary, ₹107.36 and 25 Nov / LAST CANDLE 2026-11-25 consistent, no standalone TLS/TLR lines.
Honest zero-result state: 'No patterns match the current filters' with Scan now / Refresh actions and no fabricated rows or prices.
Loading placeholder from a deliberately pending matrix response (mocked, no timers): skeleton cards with directional filter chip; no results are invented while loading.
Mocked HTTP 500 on pattern results surfaces the red 'pattern results unavailable' alert above the empty result area, with the restrictive Direction: Bearish chip used to keep the error stable.
